targets.query: default | where timestamp >= now() - 30d | where resource['service.name'] == 'claude-code' | extend feature=tostring(resource['business.feature.id']) | summarize cost_usd=sum(todouble(attributes['cost_usd'])) by attribution=iff(isempty(feature),'unattributed','attributed')

default | where timestamp >= now() - 30d | where resource['service.name'] == 'claude-code' | extend model=tostring(attributes['model']) | where isempty(model) | summarize records=count() by day=bin(timestamp, 1d) | sort by day asc

default | where timestamp >= now() - 30d | where resource['service.name'] in ('engineering-work','berserk-mcp-recommendation') | summarize last_seen=max(timestamp), records=count() by service=tostring(resource['service.name']) | sort by service asc

default | where timestamp >= now() - 30d | where resource['service.name'] == 'claude-code' | extend native_event=tostring(attributes['event.name']), legacy_event=tostring(attributes['claude.type']) | where isnotempty(native_event) or isnotempty(legacy_event) | summarize records=count() by source=iff(isnotempty(native_event),'native','legacy')

default | where timestamp >= now() - 30d | where resource['service.name'] == 'claude-code' | where attributes['event.name'] == 'api_request' or attributes['claude.type'] == 'assistant' | extend exact=isnotnull(attributes['input_tokens']) or isnotnull(attributes['claude.tokens_input']) | summarize records=count() by token_source=iff(exact,'exact','estimated-or-missing')

default | where timestamp >= now() - 30d | where resource['service.name'] == 'berserk-mcp-recommendation' | summarize decisions=count(), last_decision=max(timestamp) by decision=tostring(attributes['decision']) | sort by decision asc

default | where timestamp >= now() - 30d | where resource['service.name'] == 'claude-code' | where attributes['event.name'] == 'api_request' | extend project=tostring(resource['business.project.id']), feature=tostring(resource['business.feature.id']) | summarize requests=count() by project_tag=iff(isempty(project),'missing','present'), feature_tag=iff(isempty(feature),'missing','present') | sort by requests desc
